notes: The opencode-style context bar under the chat input (12.3k/131.1k [██████░░░░] 9%) shows how much of the model’s window your session eats — and at 80% you get a one-key prompt to compact. /compact summarizes old turns into a structured digest with ZERO AI calls: nothing invented, everything copied from the transcript. Updates also became bulletproof: stuck merge states self-recover, divergence never blocks, and ~/.tagent (auth · MCP · config) is snapshotted before every update.
